# A range field's input has no height; its slider draws outside it

Sub of #21329. Owned by @neo-opus-ada for the Engine 14 cut (Mon 23 Nov), so no curated labels: it decides whether the range field's tile publishes, which #21140's investigation 1 answers by Thu 19 Nov.

## Context

Measured on `dev` `5b01310896`, `examples/form/field/range` at 1024 × 768, `labelPosition: 'left'`, in Playwright's Chromium, WebKit and Firefox:

| Engine | Input box | Label's middle (y) | Input's middle (y) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chromium, WebKit | 196 × **0** px | 357.5 | 362.5 |
| Firefox | 196 × 17.3 px | 358.1 | 363.1 |

The slider still looks right and takes clicks, because its track and thumb paint outside the input. What reads the box sees nothing:

- Playwright treats the input as hidden: `locator('.neo-rangefield-input').first().waitFor()` times out with `locator resolved to hidden <input … type="range" … class="neo-rangefield-input"/>`.
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --tiles` skips boxes under 2 px, so the `form-field-range` tile comes out 160 × 120 with only the label (my defect-note, 18 Nov 20:14Z). It is held out of neomjs/pages#113.
- With `labelPosition: 'top'` the box sits at y 377, below the field's own box (y 344 to 371).

## The Problem

`Range.css` places the slider with three offsets that cancel out: `margin-top: 12px` on the input, `-8px` on the track, `-5px` on the thumb. With `-webkit-appearance: none`, Chromium sizes the input from its track: removing the track's margin makes the input 4 px tall, a 10 px track makes it 10 px, so 4 px minus 8 px leaves it at 0. Firefox keeps an intrinsic height, 5 px below the label's middle.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/form/field/Range.css`: the offsets above. The themes set only `--rangefield-thumb-background` and `--rangefield-track-background`.
- `src/form/field/Range.mjs` `construct()` replaces the input's `neo-textfield-input` class with `neo-rangefield-input`, so `Text.css`'s `min-height: var(--textfield-input-height)` for text inputs does not reach it, and `Range.css` sets none.
- `.neo-textfield` has a fixed one-row height (`Text.css`), so a top label pushes the input below the field's bottom edge before and after this fix. That height belongs to the whole text field family.

Design authority: #21140, investigation 1: "Can one recipe capture every workbench stage's component by its own rectangle, in the dark theme? … An entry the recipe cannot capture stays unpublished." The recipe's `tileRegion` takes a component's content as "the union of leaves, media, text and decorated boxes", and an `input` counts, so the input's box has to hold what it paints.

## The Fix

In `resources/css/src/form/field/Range.css` only:

- `.neo-rangefield-input`: drop `margin-top: 12px` and add `min-height: 15px`, the thumb's height.
- `::-webkit-slider-runnable-track` and `::-moz-range-track`: drop `margin-top: -8px`.
- `::-webkit-slider-thumb`: `margin-top: calc((4px - 15px) / 2)`. Chromium and WebKit start the thumb at the track's top edge, so this centres the 15 px thumb on the 4 px track.
- `::-moz-range-thumb`: drop `margin-top: -5px`. Firefox centres the thumb on its own.

Checked in all three engines with these rules injected (`revert` standing in for each dropped declaration). The input is 196 × 15 px (17.3 px in Firefox) and its middle matches the label's to 0.1 px. The slider still draws on the label's middle line. With a top label, the 15 px box starts below the label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A left-labelled range field's input box is at least 15 px tall and its middle is within 1 px of the label's middle.
- [ ] AC-2: With `labelPosition: 'top'` the input box is at least 15 px tall and starts below the label's box.
- [ ] AC-3: A click on the track still sets the value at that point. This is a guard and passes on `dev` too.
- [ ] AC-4: A component spec, `test/playwright/component/form/field/Range.spec.mjs`, covers AC-1 to AC-3: AC-1 and AC-2 red on `dev`, green at head.
- [ ] AC-5 (post-merge): `captureExamples.mjs --tile examples/form/field/range` writes the tile with its slider, and it joins the field tiles on `neomjs/pages`.

## Out of Scope

- The text field family's fixed one-row height under a top label (`Text.css`).
- The focused slider shows no focus indicator (`outline: none`, nothing replaces it). Captured as a defect-note.
- Tick marks (`afterSetTickmarks` is a `todo`) and the value-in-label spec (#19145, a unit spec in another file).

## Avoided Traps

- `height: 15px` instead of `min-height`: in a top-label column, the input's `flex: 1` shrinks a fixed height to 6 px (measured). `min-height` holds it.
- Giving the input back `neo-textfield-input`: that class brings the text input's border, padding and background.
